gaps.title: No partial-gravity combustion data in PSI
gaps.text: No PSI combustion investigation was run at Moon or Mars gravity. Habitat presets at partial gravity can only be compared with microgravity and 1 g results.
notes: Upcoming LUCI and FM2 experiments will add partial-gravity data.
E-FIELD Flames uses an electric field to mimic some gravity effects. It is a partial proxy, not real partial gravity.
Microgravity and 1 g results bound the expected behavior in between.
